question: In a certain code language, ‘BOWLER’ is coded as ‘TFNXQC’. What is the code for ‘BOWMAN’ in that code language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7b3b7907e639b09b5b84cb38c81ebdf705b78f9f53e793f65fbd5afd6ecaa7b3.png] 

The logic followed here is:

‘BOWLER’ is coded as ‘TFNXQC’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b49ee08ed1ea136fac80c3d1c8e0d326abd0ef3057039826c7082fa9da420b3.png] 

Similarly, the word of code 'BOWMAN' is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/50202b2a42eb9e6ee25c553b02cd27a55129519d22bba3c752578f5f9561bbcf.png] 

So, 'BOWMAN' will be coded as 'PBOXQC'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
